ladder_measured.RM_GrayChitin: gray shell, value 2.5, sharp 0.54 blunt 0.6, insulation 12, colour (56,56,56)
ladder_measured.RM_MediumChitin: tough chitin, value 5.0, sharp 1.1 blunt 0.8, insulation 15, colour (63,114,123)

load_check: RM_MediumChitin and RM_GrayChitin live in LanternDeeps; LanternDeeps and LeaningScrub both fold into the composed RimMandrake.Biomes (Biomes.compose.json), and SWBestiary hard-depends on mandrake.rm.biomes, so every new reference resolves in one load.

reasons: giant earwig, size 3.0, BeetleLikeWithClaw, LeatherAmount 30; Jurassic-donor arthropod with no canon_references entry (non-SW)
tough chitin is the top generic ladder rung; the 12 MediumChitin producers span 0.79-3.0; heavier chitins are species-unique (Royal) or another biome's (Black, LongShade)
the donor's DinoChitin item left with its DLL; Leather_Lizard (the vertebrate ports' choice) would be wrong for an arthropod
purple rhinoceros beetle, size 1.5, inside the rung's band
RSW_RoyalChitin (purple) considered and rejected: it is RSW_RoyalRhino's unique high-value material, not a ladder rung; the ruling sends producers to the one ladder
teal leather from a purple beetle is cosmetic only; no written rule ties leather colour to the creature's
camel spider, size 1.5, predator; same reasoning as Holcorobeus, minus the colour question
proto-termite, size 3.0, predator; same reasoning as Baseopsis

donor BMT_AaroxisDendoriaPupa (Biomes! Caverns 2969748433, 1.6) set LeatherAmount 2 and NO leatherDef, so this is the donor's own bug, not something we invented; larva carries WeakChitin, adult GrayChitin
pupa precedent in this file: RSW_FacetMothPupa (CrystalChitin) and RSW_SmogPupa (ToxiChitin) carry the adult's chitin; the pick matches

the adult has LeatherAmount 0 (donor value, a silk producer), so the pupa yields 2 gray shell while the adult yields none: odd, but it is the donor's amount, value 5 silver in total, and out of scope for a leatherDef pick
donor BMT_RoyalRhinoPupa also had LeatherAmount 2 and no leatherDef; adult BMT_RoyalRhino -> BMT_RoyalChitin, ours -> RSW_RoyalChitin
adult-chitin pupa precedent as above; 2 x value 10 = 20 silver per pupa, so it does not undercut the adult (size 3) as a royal-chitin source
alternative RM_WeakChitin (the larva's) is defensible too, but breaks the FacetMoth/Smog pupa precedent
